name: Melbourne's Crazy Clock Challenge 2020
information: # The competition is cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. **Please note**: There is no 3x3x3 being held. **The main event of this competition is Clock.** This competition will immediately precede FMC World. If you pay for this competition you will get FMC World FREE! **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/speedcubingau) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!
